title: DECLARE  PSALM 91 PRAYER EVERY MORNING AND WATCH YOUR LIFE CHANGE
text: Beloved, before we go into the realm of the spirit this morning, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this prayer. I want you to send it to somebody. There are people in your world. There are people in your sphere of influence who are under siege. There are people who have been marked for destruction. There are people who the enemy has circled waiting for the opportune moment to strike. And God is saying, "I want you to be a vessel of deliverance." Share this prayer. Send it to your family members. Send it to your colleagues. Send it to that friend who has been going through inexplicable hardship. Because what I'm about to release is not ordinary prayer. This is warfare. This is militant. This is the kind of prayer that shifts atmospheres, that breaks yolks, that cancels evil verdicts, that frustrates the counsel of the wicked. You see, the scripture we are about to engage is not just a passage. [music] It is a covenant document. Psalm 91 is not poetry for religious sentiment. It is a legal instrument in the realm of the spirit. When you declare Psalm 91, you are not begging God. No, no, no. You are enforcing what has already been settled in the courts [music] of heaven. You are activating divine protection that was purchased for you before the foundation of the world. And this is why the enemy fights the declaration of this psalm with everything he has [music] because he knows that when a child of God understands the power resident in these verses, his assignment against that life is nullified. Let me tell you what happens when you declare Psalm 91 every morning. You are not just saying words. You are establishing jurisdiction. You are setting the spiritual tone for your day. You are announcing to principalities and powers, to territorial spirits, to demons of frustration and failure. You have no authority over my life today. Glory to God. You are stepping into a dimension where angels receive assignment concerning you. where the God of heaven positions his arsenal of protection around your going out and your coming in. There is a reason why this psalm begins with he that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high. Dwelling is not visitation. Many believers are visitors to God's [music] presence. They come when there is trouble. They come when there is crisis. But dwelling dwelling speaks of habitation, of residence, of consistent fellowship. And it is from that place of intimacy that invincibility is released. You cannot access the protection of Psalm 91 from a distance. You cannot claim it while living in canality and spiritual lukewarmness. No. The covering of the Almighty is activated by proximity to his presence. I prophesy to somebody right now. every satanic arrow that has been fired at you in the night season, every evil pronouncement, every covenant of darkness that has been established against your bloodline as you declare this psalm, it is nullified by the blood of Jesus. That thing that has been following your family for generations, that pattern of failure at the edge of breakthrough, that spirit of untimely death, that cycle of sickness and disease, I decree and declare it ends today in the name of Jesus. Listen to me carefully. When the Bible says in verse one, he that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. This is covenant language. The Hebrew word for shadow here is cell. And it speaks of defense, of covering, of shade from scorching heat, protection from the elements. It means that when you dwell in his presence, you are enveloped in divine covering that is impenetrable to the weapons of darkness. The shadow of the almighty is not symbolic. It is tangible in the realm of the spirit. It is a force field of divine protection that demons cannot penetrate. You know in the ancient near east to be under someone's shadow meant to be under their authority and protection. When a king cast his shadow over you it meant you were safe, you were covered, you were defended by all the resources of that kingdom. How much more when it is the shadow of El Shadai, the allsufficient one, the God who is more than enough, the God who lacks nothing, who needs nothing, who is everything. When his shadow covers you, what can man do to you? What can witchcraft do to you? What can evil altars do to you? I'm telling you, there are dimensions of protection that many believers have never experienced because they have never learned to dwell. They pray occasionally. They read their Bible when it's convenient. They worship when they feel like it. But dwelling is a lifestyle. It is waking up in his presence. It is going to sleep meditating on his word. It is walking through your day conscious of his overshadowing [music] presence. And when you do this, when you make this your pattern, something happens in the spirit realm. You become untouchable to the kingdom of darkness. Verse two says, "I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God. In him will I trust." This is a personal declaration. This is not what the pastor said. This is not what the prophet said. This is what you must say. I will say. You must open your mouth and declare it. You [music] must prophesy to your own life. You must announce to the forces of hell, "The Lord is my refuge. He is my fortress. He is my God." When you personalize the covenant, you activate it. When you confess it with your mouth, angels [music] move. When you declare it with faith, demons flee. A refuge is a place of safety, a shelter from danger. A fortress is a military [music] stronghold, a place of defense that cannot be conquered. And God is saying, "I am both for you." He's your safe place when the storms of life rage. He's your fortress when the enemy advances against you. In him, not in your strength, not in your wisdom, not in your connections, but in him you trust. This is the foundation of supernatural protection. Trust [music] that is anchored in the character and faithfulness of God. Let me give you understanding. Many believers are trying to access divine protection while trusting in their own arrangements. They've made backup plans. They've positioned themselves with the right people. They've secured their future through worldly means and then they wonder why Psalm 91 doesn't work for them. You cannot serve two masters. You cannot trust God and trust in the arm of flesh simultaneously. The protection of Psalm 91 is released to those [music] whose confidence is completely in the Lord, whose hope is not in man, whose security is not in this world systems. Now listen to verse three. And I want you to hear this with spiritual ears. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler and from the noisome pestilence. This is a promise, not a possibility, not a maybe, but surely. It is guaranteed. It is certain. IT IS SETTLED. HE SHALL deliver you. Not he might, not he could, but he shall. This is the language of covenant assurance. The snare of the fowler. This speaks of hidden traps, secret plots, devices that are set to capture and destroy you in the realm of the spirit. These are the strategies of the enemy that are not obvious. These are the setups, the arrangements of darkness, the evil patterns, the manipulations that are designed to derail your destiny. How many people have walked into snares? How many have been caught in situations that were orchestrated by the kingdom of darkness? But God is saying, "I will deliver you from the snare of the fowler." I prophesy to someone that evil setup you're about to walk into, the Holy Spirit will give you discernment. That business deal that looks good on the surface, but is a trap. You will see it for what it is. That relationship that the enemy has packaged as your blessing, but is actually your destruction, God will open your eyes. You will not be a victim of the fowler snare in the name of Jesus. And then he says, "And from the noisome pestilence." The word noisome means harmful, destructive, deadly. This speaks of plagues, of diseases, of pestilences that are unleashed to destroy populations. And in our generation, we have seen this. We have seen how pestilences can shut down nations, how they can kill multitudes. But there is a people who have been marked for exemption. There is a remnant who work in divine immunity. And the distinguishing factor is not their natural strength, not their medical access, but their dwelling in the secret place. Glory to God. When you are covered by the shadow of the Almighty, when you abide in his presence, there is a divine firewall that separates you from the plagues that are walking in this earth. You can be in the same room with contamination and it will not touch you. You can [music] walk through infected environments and you will come out clean. This is not presumption. This is covenant reality for those who dwell. Verse four, he shall cover thee with his feathers [music] and under his wings shalt thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. This is the language of tender protection. Like a mother bird covering her cheeks, like an eagle spreading its wings over its young. So the Lord covers those who [music] trust in him. But notice it says, "Under his wings shalt thou trust." Protection and trust are inseparable. You must position yourself under his wings. You must run to him. You must hide in him. Too many believers are trying to stay protected while living exposed. They want the covering without the commitment. They want the wings without the submission. But it doesn't work that way. If you want to be under his wings, you [music] must come close. You must stay close. You must make him your dwelling place, your hiding place, your strong tower. And his truth shall be your shield and buckler. A shield is held in the hand for frontal protection. A buckler is strapped to the arm and surrounds you. This means God's truth doesn't just protect you from attacks. You see, coming, it protects you from attacks on every side, even the ones you don't see. His truth, his word, his promises, his covenant becomes a supernatural defense system that guards you from every direction. This is why you must know the word. This is why you must hide the word in your heart. This is why declaration is not optional. It is essential. When you declare the truth of God's word, you are activating your shield. You are positioning your buckler. You are creating a force field of divine protection that the enemy cannot penetrate. Verse 5 and 6. Listen to this. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. This is comprehensive protection. This covers every time frame night and day. This covers every type of attack, terror, arrows, pestilence, destruction. Nothing is left out. Nothing is excluded. The terror by night. These are the attacks that come in darkness. The nightmares, the sleep paralysis, the night terrors, the attacks on your rest, the operations of witchcraft that are carried out in the night season. How many people are tormented at night? How many wake up more tired than when they went to sleep because there has been warfare in the spirit realm. But God is saying, you shall not be afraid. Fear is the entry point for these attacks. But when you dwell in the secret place, [music] when you abide under his shadow, fear has no place. You sleep in peace, you rest in confidence, you wake up refreshed because you are guarded by angelic security. The arrow that flies by day, these are the open attacks, the visible oppositions, the schemes that you can see. These are the attacks on your job, your business, your ministry. These are the people who rise up against you, the circumstances that seem designed to destroy you. But the promise is clear. They shall not prosper. The arrows may be fired, but they will not reach their target. Divine deflection is at work on your behalf. I decree over someone right now, every arrow of failure, every arrow of sickness, every arrow of poverty, every arrow of marital destruction that has been fired at you, I command it to catch fire and burn to ashes in the name of Jesus. It shall not land. It shall not prosper. it shall not accomplish its mission. You are covered. You are protected. You are shielded by the power of the most high God. The pestilence that walks in darkness, these are the hidden diseases, the mysterious ailments, the conditions that doctors cannot diagnose, the sicknesses that have no name, but you are exempted. You are immune. By his stripes, you are healed. And by his covering, you are protected. The destruction that waste at noonday. This speaks of sudden calamity, unexpected disaster, things that happen when you least expect them. How many people have been going about their normal day and suddenly destruction struck? But there is a people who are exempted from such calamities. There is a remnant who walk under divine protection that guards them even from the unexpected. Verse 7, a thousand shall fall at thy side and 10,000 at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. This is selective protection, this is precision coverage. People around you may be falling, circumstances around you may be collapsing, but it that destruction, that pestilence, that calamity, it shall not come near you. Not because you are better than others, but because you dwell in the secret place. Not because you deserve it, but because you are in covenant. This is not insensitivity to the suffering of others. This is the reality of covenant privilege. This is what God provides for those who make him their refuge. And instead of feeling guilty about it, you should be grateful. Instead of apologizing for it, you should be declaring it. Instead of hiding it, you should be helping others to access it by sharing this truth with them. Verse 8 says, "Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. You will be a witness but not a victim. You will see what happens to those who reject God's covering but it will not happen to you." This is not about rejoicing in the destruction of others. It is about understanding the reality of divine justice and the privilege of divine protection. Now we come to verses 9 and 10. And I need you to pay attention because this is where the psalm shifts to direct speech. Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most high, thy habitation, there shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come n thy dwelling. Because this is a word of causation. This is telling you why the protection works. Because you have made the Lord your habitation. Because you have chosen him as your dwelling place. Because you have positioned yourself in him. The protection is not random. It is not luck. It is the result of a deliberate choice to abide in him. There shall no evil befall you. This is absolute language. No evil, not some evil, not most evil, but no evil. And it doesn't just say befall. It says shall not. This is future tense. This is prophetic declaration over your life. From this day forward, no evil shall befall you. Every evil arrangement is canled. Every evil plan is frustrated. Every evil agenda is nullified. Neither shall any plague come near your dwelling. Your house is protected. Your family is protected. Your children are protected. Not just you individually, but your dwelling place, your home, your household, everything that belongs to you is covered by divine immunity. I prophesy to families right now. Every plague that has been assigned to your household, every generational cause that has been attacking your lineage, every pattern of sickness and disease that has been moving through your family tree, I decree it stops now. It shall not continue. It shall [music] not proceed. It shall not manifest. Your dwelling is sanctified by the blood of [music] Jesus. Your household is sealed by the covenant of protection. No weapon formed against your family shall prosper. Verse 11 and 12. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. [music] When you declare Psalm 91, you are not fighting alone. You are activating angelic assistance. God commands his angels concerning you. Not one angel, angels plural, a whole host of heavenly beings are given assignment over your life. Their mandate is to keep you in all your ways. Not some of your ways, not just when you're in church, not just when you are praying, but in all your ways. In your going out and coming in, in your business and your ministry, in your driving and your walking, in your sleeping and your waking. Everywhere you go, angels are assigned to you. They bear you up in their hands. This speaks of divine lifting, of supernatural support. When you should fall, you won't fall. When you should fail, you won't fail. When circumstances should crush you, they won't crush you. Because there are angels underneath you, bearing you up, holding you steady, keeping you from destruction. Lest you dash your foot against a stone, even the small things are covered. Even the minor accidents are prevented. Even the seemingly insignificant dangers are addressed. This is comprehensive care. This is total coverage. This is the kind of protection that only God can provide. Verse 13, thou shalt tread upon the lion and the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet. This is not defensive protection anymore. This is offensive authority. You move from being protected to being powerful. You move from being guarded to being a guardian. You move from being defended to being dominant. The lion represents open aggressive attacks, the intimidation tactics of the enemy, the roaring threats, the obvious dangers. The other is the snake representing hidden subtle attacks, the deception, the lies, the secret operations. The young lion is the immature but aggressive forces, the rising oppositions, the developing threats. The dragon is the ultimate symbol of satanic power. The principalities, the strongholds, the highranking demons. And God says, "You shall tread on them. You shall trample them, not they shall tread on you. You shall tread on them." This is dominion. This is authority. This is the power that Jesus gave to his disciples when he said, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt you." I prophesy to believers who have been on the defensive for too long, it is time to go on the offensive. It is [music] time to stop running from the devil and start chasing him. It is time to stop begging and start commanding. It is time to stop being a victim and start being a victor. You have authority. You have power. You have dominion. Use it. Declare it. Enforce it. Now listen to the final verses 14- 16. And these are God speaking directly. Because he had set his love upon me. Therefore will I deliver him. I will set him on high because he had known my name. He shall call upon me and I will answer him. I will [music] be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him. With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation. These verses are the divine response to a life of dwelling. God himself speaks and declares. [music] What he will do for those who love him, who know his name, who call upon him. He will deliver. He will set on high. He will answer. He will be with them. He will honor them. He will satisfy them with long life. He will show them his salvation. This is the covenant package. This is the total benefit. This is what God provides for those who make him their dwelling place. And all of this, all of these promises, all of this protection, all of this power is activated when you declare this psalm every morning. So, let me lead you now in militant prayer. Let me lead you in a declaration that will set the tone for your day, that will activate angelic assistance, that will frustrate the counsel of the wicked, that will establish divine protection over your life. Open your mouth and declare after me. Declare with me. Declare from the depths of your spirit. I dwell in the secret place of the most high God. I abide under the shadow of the almighty. I am not a visitor. I am a resident in his presence. I am hidden in him. I am covered by him. I am protected by him. The Lord is my refuge and my fortress. He is my God and in him I trust completely. I do not trust in man. I do not trust in my own wisdom. I do not trust in the systems of this world. My confidence is in the Lord alone. The Lord delivers me from the snare [music] of the fowler. Every trap that has been set for me, I am delivered. Every evil arrangement, I escape. Every setup of the enemy, I see it and avoid it. The Lord delivers me from the noisome pestilence. [music] Every plague, every disease, every sickness that is walking in the earth, I am exempted. I am immune. I am protected. He covers me with his feathers. Under his wings, I trust. [music] His truth is my shield and my buckler. I am surrounded by divine protection. I am guarded on every side. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. I shall not be afraid of the terror by night. I cancel every nightmare. I destroy every spirit of fear. I command every demon that operates in the night season. You have no access to my L. I to my sleep to my rest. I decree peaceful sleep. I [music] decree divine rest. I decree angelic protection over my night season. I shall not be afraid of the arrow that flies by day. Every arrow of failure, I command you to go back to sender. Every arrow of sickness, catch fire [music] and burn. Every arrow of poverty, you shall not land. Every arrow of marital destruction, you are destroyed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I am protected from every visible and invisible attack. I shall not be afraid of the pestilence that works in darkness. I shall not be afraid of the destruction that waste at noon day. I am covered. I am shielded. I am protected at all times in all seasons from all attacks. A thousand may fall at my side, 10,000 at my right hand, but it shall not come near me. I am exempted. I am separated. I am protected by divine decree. I am sealed by the blood of Jesus. I am covered by the covenant of protection because I have made the Lord my habitation. Because I have made the most high my dwelling place, there shall no evil befall me. No evil scheme, no evil plan, no evil arrangement shall prosper against my life. Neither shall any plague come near my dwelling. My home is protected. My family is covered. My household is sealed. Every generational cause is broken. Every pattern of destruction is canled. The Lord has given his angels charge over me. Angels of the Lord, I receive your assignment. I declare you at work in my life. You keep me in all my ways. You bear me up in your hands. You prevent accidents. You stop disasters. You block evil. You execute divine protection on my behalf. I am not alone. I am not unguarded. I walk with angelic assistance. I tread upon the lion and the adder. I trample the young lion and the dragon under my feet. I have authority over every demonic attack. I have power over every satanic operation. I am not a victim. I am a victor. I am not defeated. I am more than a conqueror. I enforce the victory of Jesus Christ. I decree that every enemy under my feet stays under my feet because I have set my love upon the Lord. He delivers me. He sets me on high because I know his name. Yahweh, Jehovah El Shadai, Adonai, [music] Jehovah Gyra, Jehovah Rafa, Jehovah Nissi. I am protected. I call upon him and he answers me. He is with me in trouble. He delivers me from every situation. He honors me. He satisfies me with long life. He shows me his salvation. I decree and declare this is my portion. This is my inheritance. This is my covenant right. I am covered by Psalm 91. I am protected by the most high. I am shielded by the almighty. I am guarded by angels. I am defended by divine power and no weapon, no strategy, no plan, no scheme of the enemy shall [music] prosper against me. Every evil verdict I cancel, every evil pronouncement I nullify, every witchcraft operation I destroy, every satanic conspiracy I frustrate, every demonic assignment I terminate in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I seal this declaration with the blood of Jesus. I activate this covenant by faith. I enforce this protection by authority and I decree it is established. It is settled. It is done in Jesus mighty name. Now I want you to understand something very important. This is not a one-time prayer. This is a daily declaration. This is a morning ritual. This is how you start your day. Before you check your phone, before you talk to anyone, before you engage with the world, you declare Psalm 91. You remind the forces of darkness who you belong to, you activate your covenant protection. You position yourself under the shadow of the Almighty. Every morning when you wake up, the enemy is waiting to see what kind of day you are going to have. He's watching to see if you walk in fear or faith, in worry or worship, in anxiety or authority. And when you declare Psalm 91, you are announcing today is covered. Today is protected. Today is sealed. You are setting the spiritual atmosphere for the next 24 hours. Listen, there are people who wonder why they keep experiencing the same attacks, the same troubles, the same problems, and it's because they never learn to establish their day in the word of God. They wake up and immediately engage with negativity, the news, social media, complaining, worrying, and they wonder why their day goes downhill. But when you start your day declaring divine protection, declaring covenant promises, declaring the word of God over your life, you are building a spiritual fortress that the enemy cannot penetrate. This is not religious routine. This is spiritual warfare. This is not empty repetition. This is prophetic declaration. Every time you speak Psalm 91, you are releasing faith. You are activating angels. You are enforcing covenant. You are frustrating demonic assignments. You are positioning yourself for divine protection. And I'm telling you, when you make this your practice, when you commit to declaring Psalm 91 every morning, you will begin to see a difference. You will begin to notice divine protection in ways you never noticed before. You will escape dangers you didn't even know were there. You will avoid traps that were set for you. You will walk through minefields and come out untouched because the covenant of protection is active over your life. There are testimonies waiting to happen in your life. There are miracles waiting to manifest. There are deliverances waiting to occur. And they are all connected to your willingness to engage this psalm, to declare it, to believe it, to live in the reality of it. So I'm charging you today. Make this your confession. Make this your declaration. Make this your daily practice. Wake up every morning and declare Psalm 91 over your life, over your family, over [music] your household. Don't wait until trouble comes. Don't wait until there's a crisis. Establish your protection before the attack comes. Build your fortress before the enemy advances. Activate your angels before danger arises. And as you [music] do this, as you make this your lifestyle, you will walk in a dimension of divine protection that will amaze you. You will experience exemption that will confound your enemies. You will manifest immunity that will testify to the faithfulness of God. I prophesy to you, your days of being vulnerable are over. Your season of exposure is finished. From this day forward, you walk in divine covering. You walk in supernatural protection. You walk in covenant immunity. The shadow of the Almighty is over you. The angels of the Lord are with you. The power of the most high surrounds you. And nothing, no weapon, no scheme, no plan, no attack shall prosper against you. Receive it, believe it, declare it, walk in it in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
